notes: Fixed the app freezing on "Opening installer..." during in-app updates. Improved error messages for update/release-notes fetch failures.

Categories tab is now functional (Login, Card, Mobile Banking, API Keys, Keystore, OAuth Client, Zip, Backup Codes) with per-category browsing. Added Profile section (avatar, name, bio, linked account). Added Settings > Updates (release notes, manual/auto update checks, configurable check frequency).

Biometric unlock, hardware back-button handling, sign-in banner, external links now open in the system browser, favicon fallback for offline icons, export now uses a real save dialog, friendlier error messages, and the in-app update system itself.
